properties.name: auth.service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the authentication service.

properties.name: wallet.service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the wallet service. All payment execution (M-Pesa, PayPal, Stripe, Flutterwave, NOWPayments) now lives there; this service only calls its internal debit endpoint.

properties.name: internal.service.api-key
properties.description: Shared internal-service API key sent as X-API-Key on service-to-service calls (currently wallet-service's /internal/payment). Use the exact same value across every Premisave microservice — no default, since a wrong-but-present placeholder caused a confusing 401 at request time instead of a clear failure at startup.

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Base64-encoded secret key used to sign and verify JWT tokens. Must match across all services.

properties.name: rate-limit.requests-per-minute
properties.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per minute per user (or per IP if unauthenticated) before rate limiting kicks in. Enforced against a Redis-backed bucket shared across all instances.

properties.name: ad.promotion.daily-rate
properties.description: Daily rate charged for promoting an ad listing, in the default currency.

properties.name: ad.promotion.default-currency
properties.description: Default currency code used for ad promotion charges (e.g. USD).

properties.name: ad.promotion.expiry-check-cron
properties.description: Cron expression controlling how often AdPromotionService checks for and deactivates expired promotions. Standard 6-field Spring cron (seconds minutes hours day-of-month month day-of-week).

properties.name: frankfurter.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for the Frankfurter currency exchange rate API. Display-only conversion now — actual payment settlement happens in wallet-service.

properties.name: frontend.url
properties.description: Frontend application URL used as the default CORS allowed-origin when cors.allowed-origins is not set.

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins, e.g. 'https://app.premisave.com,https://admin.premisave.com'. Falls back to frontend.url for single-origin setups.

values.description: Suppresses hostname resolution warnings from Spring Cloud.
